title: Public API documentation
description: For a change to a public API or SDK: a reference generated from the contract, examples that run, a changelog and a deprecation notice before removal.

sources.title: Diátaxis, a systematic approach to technical documentation
Write the Docs, Docs as Code

rules.instruction: Build the API reference from the contract file in the repository instead of writing it by hand.
rules.verification: Check that the documentation build reads the contract file and that the published reference matches its version.

rules.instruction: Run the code examples and SDK samples of the documentation in CI against the release candidate.
rules.verification: Check the CI job that runs the examples and its result for the release candidate.

rules.instruction: Add an entry to the public changelog for each change of behaviour, listing breaking changes first with a migration path.
rules.verification: Open the changelog and check the entry for the change.

rules.instruction: Mark a deprecated operation as deprecated in the contract and publish its removal date and migration guide before the deprecation period starts.
rules.verification: Check the deprecated flag in the contract, the removal date in the reference and the link to the migration guide.
